title: Are digital cameras still worth buying in 2026? - Engadget
summary: A digital camera can mean anything from the compact point-and-shoot cameras with fixed lenses to the high-end mirrorless cameras with interchangeable lenses. Unlike smartphone cameras that take care of most of the editing, the process with digital cameras can be very involved.
